answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

双面板复合图：绿色/蓝色柱与橙色三角点叠加；各面板有标题、图内图例、竖排国家代码和独立纵轴。A面板还须为TUR绘制隔开的0–50尺度，其他类别用0–5。单位置于轴顶，并保留注释、来源及StatLink。

**定位一个值难在哪**

A面板GBR的“One year ago”值2.8没有印数；纵轴每格1，而5%容差仅±0.14，必须同时依靠面板、国家代码和系列标签。

**不确定的**

B面板GBR的柱与三角形接近3.8；2.8也在多处出现。给定数值序列本身不能唯一证明对应标记，只能结合阅读顺序判断。

worked_example.why_hard: Ten-unit ticks require interpolation; TUR uses a separate scale.

components.evidence: Green or blue bars and orange triangles are overlaid in both panels.
Panel A shows 0–5 and 0–50 scales; Panel B shows 0–8.
Both legends overlay the upper portion of their plot areas.
Panel A and Panel B each carry their own two-entry legend.
“A. Trimmed mean inflation” and “B. Inflation expectations, one year ahead” appear above panels.
Axis headings read “Y-o-y % changes” and “%” above bare numeric ticks.
“Y-o-y % changes” and “%” sit above their respective value axes.
Country-code tick labels are rotated vertically beneath both panels.
Category ticks use codes including “GBR”, “EA”, “CRC” and “FRA”.
EA Latest bars are blue while other Latest bars are green; the legends do not explain blue.
The EA bar is blue in each panel while peer bars are green.
Light horizontal grid lines cross both plots; no vertical grid lines are drawn.
